integrity: Proof is analytical, with exact root isolation and supporting checker. Same-model review completed; no independent mathematical audit, certification, or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The Hamming-distance zero-count is an upper bound and need not be saturated in dimensions beyond four; detailed sign diagram and sharp coordinate norms are proved only for Q4. Results apply to unweighted combinatorial graph Laplacians squared. Literature comparisons are bounded, and no claim of complete historical priority is made.
title: Distance-controlled zero crossings and the first reentrant biharmonic heat kernel on Boolean cubes
